title: Charlie Rooke interviewed by Non-Billable on the evolution of legal finance
summary: Charlie Rooke speaks to Non-Billable on the evolution of legal finance. Learn more.
body_markdown:
As legal finance becomes an increasingly established tool for businesses and law firms in the UK, its role is expanding beyond financing the fees and expenses of a single case.


Speaking to Non-Billable, Burford Director[Charlie Rooke](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/charlie-rooke/) says, “We’re increasingly working with FTSE 100 and other international companies where using funding is simply a financing decision,” as businesses consider how to allocate capital, law firms explore alternative fee arrangements and AI creates new investment needs across the legal sector.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.nonbillable.co.uk/posts/burford-capital-charlie-rooke-new-economics-of-uk-litigation)
